definitions.TR: bitmask6 = R2 | T4; RT in machine records means the same corner
definitions.boundary: Count one block if any requested edge fails abs(gap)<1e-6
definitions.unavoidable: For a P-constrained offending block, another immutable P endpoint extends farther, or a locked width/height cannot fit its upper limit with nonnegative coordinates; sufficient lower-bound proof only
definitions.attribution: An unavoidable soft violation is not proof of a postprocessor defect. Remaining failures need candidate-level analysis; no claim of repairability from this bound alone
